description:
This dataset contains the raw data files associated with the manuscript “Identification of a stereotypic molecular arrangement of endogenous glycine receptors at spinal cord synapses” S.A. Maynard, P. Rostaing, N. Schaefer, O. Gemin, A. Candat, A. Dumoulin, C. Villmann, A. Triller, C.G. Specht. eLife 2021 (doi: 10.7554/eLife.74441).
https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2021.09.09.459599v2

The repository comprises all the raw data files for confocal imaging, super-resolution PALM and SRRF imaging, electron microscopy and electrophysiology utilised in the manuscript.
An accompanying README text file describes the IDs for each sample in each dataset, which information was used from each dataset and which figure each dataset corresponds to.
citation: Maynard, Stephanie A.; Rostaing, Philippe; Schaefer, Natasha; Gemin, Olivier; Candat, Adrien; Dumoulin, Andréa; et al. (2022). Identification of a stereotypic molecular arrangement of endogenous glycine receptors at spinal cord synapses. figshare. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.17816747.v1
title: Identification of a stereotypic molecular arrangement of endogenous glycine receptors at spinal cord synapses
